questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content: Fluorobenzene (C<sub>6</sub>H<sub>5</sub>F) can be synthesized in the laboratory

options.content: by heating phenol with HF and KF
from aniline by diazotisation followed by heating the diazonium salt with HBF<sub>4</sub>
by direct fluorination of benzene with F<sub>2</sub> gas
by reacting bromobenzene with NaF solution
